name: Framer AI
summary: Framer AI extends Framer's website and UI design platform with AI-powered prototyping and content generation. Designers can generate layouts, copy, and interactive components from natural language prompts, streamlining the web design process for both beginners and professionals.
description: Framer AI extends Framer's website and UI design platform with AI-powered prototyping and content generation. Designers can generate layouts, copy, and interactive components from natural language prompts, streamlining the web design process for both beginners and professionals. Framer is an AI website builder for designers and teams. Generate editable pages, refine every detail on canvas, and publish with CMS, hosting, SEO, and analytics. AI Layouts: Generate page structures with text prompts. Copywriting: Instantly create and edit website copy. Component Library: Access interactive UI building blocks. Live Preview: See and test designs in real time.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Access Framer AI
howToUse.description: Create a Framer account and access the Framer AI feature via the web dashboard.

howToUse.title: Start a New Project
howToUse.description: Begin a new site or UI design project within the Framer editor.

howToUse.title: Generate Layouts & Copy
howToUse.description: Use natural language prompts to generate layouts, website copy, or interactive elements instantly.

howToUse.title: Edit & Customize
howToUse.description: Refine the generated content, drag-and-drop components, and preview your work in real time.

howToUse.title: Publish or Export
howToUse.description: Publish your finished site with one click, or export code/assets for further development.
